content:
The next major iPhone software version is iOS 27, which is coming soon. Here's what we know about the expected iOS 27 public release timeline.

iOS 27 will launch in September, likely in the middle of the month.

iOS 27 is the next major software version for iPhone, and it has been in beta testing all summer.

After months of beta testing, Apple has always released new major iOS versions to all users in September.

Therefore, iOS 27 is expected to launch in September, likely in the middle of the month.

Here's a look at Apple's iOS release dates over the past several years:

  • iOS 26: September 15 (Monday)
  • iOS 18: September 16 (Monday)
  • iOS 17: September 18 (Monday)
  • iOS 16: September 12 (Monday)

Following that pattern, iOS 27 is expected to launch around September 14 (Monday).

The official date is typically announced at Apple's annual iPhone event, which usually takes place the week before. The iPhone 18 Pro is expected to make its first appearance around September 9.

iOS 27 brings new features to Wallet, Photos, Messages, Notes, and more, with upgrades to CarPlay and AirPods, plus a major AI overhaul for Siri and other changes.

This update will be compatible with all iPhone models that support iOS 26.

What new features and changes are you most looking forward to in iOS 27? Let us know in the comments.
